pr_title: add click on title_bar to focus a container

issue_context.title: Clicking tabs does not switch focus
issue_context.body: In i3wm, one of the laziest ways to switch to another tab is to click its "decoration" (for the lack of a better term, I mean the rectangle rendered above it with the title inside).  In sway, this doesn't do anything (yet).

review_comments:
This should probably live outside of the if statement, right?
I don't think so.
If the user doesn't click on any title_bar process should continue.
